summary.decision_summary: Two Buck Luck won by 27.9. Two Buck Luck left 20.4 lineup points on the table, while ZSzizzle left 8.5.

summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Two Buck Luck
summary.winner_reason: Two Buck Luck won by 27.9, led by a 30.7-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Javonte Williams (29.5) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (23.2).
summary.loser_reason: ZSzizzle could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 30.7 points. Rams scored 2.0. A best legal lineup added 8.5, still short of the 27.9-point margin.
